blockers.reason: Factory fits SIDE SAUCER 69, END OF TUBE 85, BALL SHOOTER 101. Both related tables drive two far-separated bulb meshes from 69 and omit 85/101. Owner repair establishes the J2-9 pair and observes separate tube-exit/shooter pairs, but neither prose nor current photos locate and trace every socket. Need socket-to-A9J2-9/A9J2-17/A9J3-10 tracing or a numbered factory location drawing, plus a measured top view for the shooter socket. No helper or mirrored coordinate is promoted.

Bare AC GI branches are proven, but no complete physical count/location map is printed. Modeled bulb candidates do not prove total quantity or string membership; cabinet/backbox quantities remain unknown. Need a complete annotated socket/branch survey.

Figure V validates 38 of 39 checked placements plus three explicitly justified flipper/bank projections. End-of-tube-lane 1 fails the fit (0.0904 control, 0.0783 callout); tube switch 27 and rebound 26 have leaderless labels inside broad outlines, while release-stack sensors 2/28 and coil 8 are only mechanism-region projections. Controlled lamps and tube bulbs lack numbered socket callouts; their exact retained coordinates remain observed. Need independent socket/leaf locations or an attainable measured physical survey for these specific placements.

Auxiliary output-7 addresses 72/88/104/120 publish sustained state in the retained service/gameplay runs despite W-1207-3 positively showing N/U outputs with no SCR/load. The driver proves publication, not the ROM cause or a meaningful virtual function. Availability remains unknown with observed provenance and virtual spatial non-applicability. Need ROM/PIA-write evidence establishing the cause before settling the runtime disposition; do not infer an omitted bulb.

callout_check.read_by: Primary GPT Sol, independent native-pixel visual reads on100px gridded render, approximately5px precision. Pixel centers were read from the factory scan, never back-computed from table coordinates. Labels with no identified individual part are excluded.
callout_check.rule: A placement is validated when its own callout on the factory location drawing (each callout paired with at most one placement of its label, nearest first) lands within 0.07 normalized of it under two least-squares fits of that page: one on independently read controls (jet-bumper caps and flipper pivots, or another crisp mechanism feature where balloons hide a pivot), and one, measured leave-one-out, on the page's other callout reads, from which any read beyond the limit is dropped. Placements without such a read keep their table status. Placements measured on a drawing are never checked against it.
